summary: SR Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: SRBK), the holding company for Somerset Regal Bank, filed a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share. The dividend is payable October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026. The filing was signed by Christopher J. Pribula, Chief Executive Officer. No advisor, strategic transaction, stake, premium, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary capital-return announcement, not a special situation. No deal terms were stated.
